content: Multi-host nix-config repos converge on: flake.nix with mkHost/homeManagerConfiguration helpers; hosts/<name>/ per machine with default.nix + hardware-configuration.nix + home.nix; shared modules/ dir split into nixos/ + home/ (lovesegfault splits modules/{nixos,darwin,home,shared}); registry either auto-discovery of hosts/ or a host list/attrset. Key idiom: one portable home.nix imported by BOTH the nixosSystem home-manager.users.<name> path AND homeManagerConfiguration standalone path — same file, two entry points (dsestu multi-host-flake guide, Misterio77, zemdregon NixOS-with-HM walkthrough with nixos-26.05 + release-26.05). Host entry stays thin; heavy lifting in shared modules. Mature repos add roles/profiles layering but plain imports + modules/ dir is the honest minimum for 1-2 hosts.
